newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hoechst's drugs unit HMR posts stronger results.
newsitem.headline: Hoechst's drugs unit HMR posts stronger results.

text.p: German drugs and chemicals group Hoechst AG said on Wednesday that its drugs unit Hoechst Marion Roussel performed well last year and is expected to be an engine to growth this year as well.
In a statement Hoechst said HMR's 1996 operating profit surged 217 percent to 2.2 billion marks with sales rising 20 percent to 13 billion marks.
The group said that despite pressure on prices, HMR benefitted from increased volume sales.

Separately the group's crop protection unit AgrEvo, run jointly with Schering AG, posted a 47 percent rise in its 1996 operating profit to 232 million marks with sales rising to 3.6 billion marks after 3.0 billion marks in 1995.
Hoechst's Behring Diagnostics increased its sales by 16 percent to 930 million marks with operating profit swinging to a profit of 88 million marks from an 8 million mark loss.
Hoechst on Tuesday said it planned to run the diagnostics division with a partner in the form of a joint venture but has not announced that partner yet.
